entries.title: 1 Kings 9:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
my brother. 5:1,2; Am 1:9 Cabul. that is, Displeasing, or dirty.Josephus says that {Cabul,} in the Phoenician language, signifies [ouk areskon,] displeasing; and that these cities were situated in the neighbourhood of Tyre. Most commentators are persuaded that the city Cabul in the tribe of Asher was one; and probably from this Hiram took occasion to give this name to all the other cities which Solomon had ceded to him.

entries.title: 1 Kings 9:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
A.M. 2989-3029. B.C. 1015-975. the reason. 21; 5:13 to build. 10; 6:38; 7:1; 2Ch 8:1 Millo.Millo is said to have been a deep valley, between the ancient city of Jebus and the city of David on mount Zion. This Solomon filled up, and built upon; and it became a fortified place, and a place for public assemblies.

24; 11:27; Jud 9:6,20; 2Sa 5:9; 2Ki 12:20 the wall. Ps 51:18 Hazor.Probably the city Hazor in Naphtali, and the famous capital of Jabin, situated in the lake Merom or Semechon, and placed by Josephus south of Tyre, near Ptolemais.
